svg.title: Where the AI's words go and how each place is guarded
svg.desc: The answer of the AI must fit its schema and hold nothing like a secret. Its texts for the comment are cleaned before they are posted. Its reasons are put on one line and cleaned, at most 280 characters, before they become a rationale on the timeline or a line of the log and the job summary; a possible security report gets a fixed rationale. The log prints them while workflow commands are turned off with a random token, and errors are escaped. The schema and the model reach the command line of the engine only in a form that adds no arguments.
